chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa', from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Udaym ibn al-Hurr who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has set a limit for women, once every month.

key_terms.النِّسَاء: Women — the subject of this jurisprudential ruling
key_terms.حَدَّ: Set a limit/appointed — here referring to God's decree of the monthly menstrual cycle
key_terms.مَرَّة: Once — indicating the frequency of occurrence per month

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the menstrual cycle and its divine appointment?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) declares that God has appointed a monthly occurrence (menstruation/haydh) for women. This hadith is the opening narration of the chapter on menstruation (haydh) in al-Kafi, establishing the foundational ruling that the menstrual cycle is a divinely ordained period with specific jurisprudential implications for ritual purity and worship.
